title: Numerical job limits
help: These limits cover the numerical job across its slices and retries. Active time measures numerical work, not elapsed waiting time.
sliceHelp: A slice cannot exceed the whole-job limits. Retrying resumes saved progress; an interrupted reservation remains fully charged. Completed slices charge their actual use.
invalid: Enter whole-job and slice limits within the displayed ranges. A slice cannot exceed the whole job. Your entries are retained.
publicContext: Numerical job limits: {operations} operations and {active} ms active work; each slice: {sliceOperations} operations and {sliceActive} ms active work. Retrying preserves charged work.
